chapter: Inside the Basie rhythm section and band family
title: Basie's secret: he wants to be sent
summary: The Danses and Greene reflect on Basie's gift as rhythmic and on how simple his leadership is.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: Yeah, well, it's a very unique thing for somebody like that who is so reticent almost -- I mean --- since he speaks so little (laugh).

That's right. It really is. You had to figure out that -- you could feel it. You could feel how Basie feels. You look at him -- I can -- and I'm sure everybody, you know, knows him after he's been there long enough to realize what's going on.
Well, but, you know, if you take also the fact that, I mean we know he can play more piano than he does ---
But, I mean, he's not a virtuoso, --
It's very remarkable that he can I mean, so there's -- as you said, it's a force.
I mean, his gift is rhythmic, really.
Oh, the secret -- the thing -- the secret of it is that he wants to be sent. You know, it's simple.
It's -- he wants it to be the real thing. He wants to swing and get sent and be that way.
And, this is what he asks of the band (laugh).
He's not asking it to be this way or that way or this -- .
All -- he wants it to send him.
He wants it to be that way. And, this is what Freddie means. And all the time it's sending him he's looking at the guys and he's getting sent --
-- and the guys are all pleased --
-- and everything's together and right. And, as Freddie says -- if anything is at all out of line, you know -- it's a little joke to him --
-- and he just casts his eye there --
-- and the guy gets the message.
And this is -- you know -- how many things can be simple like that, you know? It's great to be simple.
It was much easier then, than it is today.
I mean, it does require more control today.
